campaign: Deliver multimodal Qwen3.8-Flash-Next UD-IQ4_XS and meet native Strata performance

paragraphs.text: overgo improves models, and itself, through its own inference and training, unattended. Every row closes or speeds up the improvement loop (measure, find the gap, train or change, judge on held-out data), or directly serves inference or training; otherwise it is not filed. The scorecard's gaps generate the work. Progress is each scorecard cell against its previous measurement, not a count of landings: there is no passed state and no promotion. Rows that let a full measurement run finish rank above rows that only harden or slim it, and a run that cannot finish (killed, or with cells that did not pass) outranks every other row.

Finish partly landed rows before opening new ones. A consolidation reuses an existing owner and deletes the implementations it replaces in the same landing. A new shared component is allowed only when no existing owner can serve several real consumers, and it must remove more than it adds.

One meaningful run serves every obligation whose identity and contract match: it is written once, as one record with many readers. A run never judges what it produced, and a run leaves its evidence complete by its own contract (every protocol a suite's acceptance asks for), never half-written for a later landing to trip on.

The landing gate judges the commit; the improvement cycle judges the models. The gate's verdict depends only on the tree: unit, golden, hermetic-fixture and small-device checks. Suites that load real models, read the live store's evidence or sweep the device belong to the cycle, declared by build tag, and the cycle runs them on the commit it measures; a store write never changes a landing's verdict. A change's landing cost is read from its diff as three independent effects: the lanes it reaches, whether it expires the inference-surface guards, and whether it needs a pinned-media reconciliation. Lanes are the main cost, so false lane reach is cut. A surface move also expires every evaluation bound to the surface, so the re-evaluation it forces counts in its cost: surface changes are batched and land before an evaluation run, never between its runs, and the guards are re-acquired once after the last of them. A batch is one coherent change, normally one to three related rows, closed before it delays a user-facing result that is ready: an operating limit, not a gate. Dependency work is verified twice, separately: its build and test closure, and the guard surface, which stops at overgodb and runrecord. A saving is the net recurring cost removed, after the replacement tests and their maintenance. A check retires only when its replacement covers the check's actual acceptance contract, whether it moves to the cycle or is deleted; the landing scorecard reports and never refuses, so it replaces no check. The gate writes all numbers; messages name causes, effects and what disappears.

A step's verify fails before the change and passes after; a verify that already passes proves nothing, so a boundary is proved by the table row that fails today. Before a landing, what the gate refuses cheaply is run locally first: the claims check after any hand edit, the invariant tables, the rules' budget and exports, and the step's verify. A refusal found after the lanes costs an hour, and a retried landing rebuilds an identical gate binary.

Each row's rationale carries four plain lines: Serves (the loop stage, or the model or capability it runs or trains), Disappears (the owner reused, the implementations deleted, the tests retired or kept), Evidence (the run and record it reads or produces, and who else reads that record), Batch (the lanes its diff reaches, whether it expires the guards, and whether it needs a media reconciliation: three independent effects, each checked against the diff).

Landing speed is protected by observing it, not by a rule. Each structural boundary (a changed path's lanes, a package kept off the inference surface, a suite kept to the cycle) is pinned as an invariant row in one table per kind, never as a new test function or a snapshot of today's lists. At each periodic review the gate's measured lines in git log are read: the share of landings that reached no lane, lane minutes per landing, and executed versus cached package counts. A rise means a misplaced check or a new false reach, fixed by moving it and adding a table row. There are no time budgets or timeouts, no ratchet baselines, and no separate tracking subsystem.

Training research is measured at the lowest cost that answers the question, reusing what exists. Optimizer math stays on the device: host Muon on the tied embedding cost about 98 s a step, and moving it took a 540-step run from about 21 hours to 6 minutes. During training only scalars cross to the host (losses, norms, brake decisions), never weights or gradients per step. Reuse comes before acquiring: cached base losses keyed by the exact window plan, existing checkpoints, held-out sets and the verdict code, before any new dataset, pass or tool. An evaluation beats a training run, a norm beats a decomposition, and a one-time computation beats a per-step one. For a training rate question the order is: post-hoc tests on existing checkpoints, then the held-out brake from the training forward against cached base losses, then a per-layer relative step size, and per-direction spectral scaling last.

User-journey performance (owner, 2026-10-05). Optimize complete journeys, measured as action to usable result: submit to first visible answer, cold model selection to usable response, cancel to actual resource release, interrupted cycle to useful progress, with loading, admission wait, execution, publication and rendering kept apart. Start from the existing native benchmarks, allocation counts and CPU profiles of repeated reads, model loads, allocations and evidence reconstruction, and keep added instrumentation only when it explains a real elapsed-time gain. In the development loop one valid gate execution is shared by every compatible plan step and obligation, and validation and reuse are scoped by the actual dependencies (kernels, generated and embedded data, models, recipes, environment, subprocess effects); an unknown dependency keeps the broader coverage. A gain is judged against total maintenance cost (production code, tests, fixtures, instrumentation, gate work and upkeep): remove repeated processing through existing owners, and decline small gains that need disproportionate machinery. Prove with behavioral regression tests and comparable benchmarks, never a new performance ratchet, selector or framework.

Pace (owner, 2026-10-09). Steps that change one mechanism land together. A measurement already taken retires the step that would take it. Work that only waits is filed early, so its wait runs while the rows between are built. A full measurement run (go run ./cmd/loop -improve) continues only at the commit it began at and is started outside a session, so no time limit ends it. Rows that move no measured result land while it runs; rows that change a served result or a timing follow it, stand side by side, and land before the next run, never between its runs.

The repository keeps Go, CUDA and HTML/JS, and extends an existing owner before it adds one. Each row begins with a measurement and fixes its acceptance before its code is written; a measurement already taken is reused when it is enough. A row deletes the implementation it replaces in the same landing; a reader that records already in the store need stays until those records are migrated. A pilot that is not accepted is taken out of the served path, and its measurements and the reason it was refused are kept.

The production growth refusal stays. A row with no count adds no net production code, which is the default: a migration deletes at least what it adds. A row that adds a mechanism before it deletes one carries a count, set in a change to the plan alone before its code, from the figure the gate's preflight gives its built change, and read from the commit the change builds on; a count set before the row is built is an estimate and says so. An item's count is for all its landings together: each landing's growth is charged to it and what is left is what the next may add. Test code, fixtures, record schemas and CUDA source are reported with each landing and not refused; a test is retired only when its replacement catches the same seeded failure.

The gate judges the candidate tree by hermetic and small-device checks; real-model quality and speed are measured by the cycle. A stored result is reused only under an unchanged identity of the code, model, recipe, data, settings and request it depends on. A request for a fresh measurement always runs, and a dependency that cannot be named keeps the wider scope. Resident resources, compiled execution and a request have separate identities, built by one mechanism into separate keys for sessions, outputs and scores. Eligibility is kept apart from selection, observations from scores, and the records that choose a candidate from the records that confirm it.

An experiment is frozen before it trains: a protocol missing a numerical gain or resource criterion is not dispatched, and a pilot does not change the acceptance of the objective it is compared with. Completing an experiment and adopting its model are separate: a complete negative or inconclusive record closes the experiment and activates nothing.

Actual GGUF tensor metadata must replace these estimates before placement is chosen.
The storage budget includes immutable shards, the projector, Strata's derived pack, acquisition staging, retained evidence and peak temporary space.
Reuse local artifacts before downloading and never create a second full model copy merely to benchmark another engine.
The initial native Strata installation uses its documented UD-IQ4_XS, image encoder and MTP draft layer.
Reuse these artifacts for later comparisons instead of acquiring another full model copy.
New optional artifacts require a demonstrated remaining gap and a derived capacity budget.

The owner requires Overgo to take no more time and use no more memory than Strata for the same model and matched workload on this PC.
Host working set, host commitment and device high-water allocation must each be no higher under the same measurement method.
Fresh activation, first usable output, total completion, prefill and decode costs must each meet the matched reference.
A faster stage or lower VRAM cannot compensate for a required latency or host-memory regression.
Quality, context contents and accepted output work remain unchanged.
Incremental delivery proceeds through native text chat, image conversations, video understanding and composition with existing speech input and output.
Every increment exposes its supported behavior through the existing web GUI and APIs.
An incomplete modality stays explicitly unavailable until its acceptance is established.
Flash-Next supplies language and visual understanding.
Speech recognition, speech synthesis and image or video generation remain compositions of Overgo's existing capability owners.
Strata's inspected server supports images but declares no video.
Video and audio therefore have independent quality and responsiveness acceptance rather than an invented Strata parity result.

The primary optimization is less processing and less memory.
Before adding a faster path, identify repeated decoding, serialization, hashing, allocation, copies, synchronization, model loads, prompt work or duplicated resident bytes that an existing owner can remove.
Distinguish logical expert bytes from physical copies in a full host arena and GPU cache.
A host complement layout must be observed rather than inferred from source support.
Count mapped bytes, resident working set, pinned RAM and physical disk copies separately.
Keep the n-gram table on storage and fetch required rows rather than materializing the full table.
Reuse buffers only when their lifetime permits it and count the bandwidth of preservation copies.
Simpler scheduling and fewer representations are preferred over another cache, pack, framework or background service.
Overlap or fusion is adopted only when the remaining dependency and resource costs justify it.
Each change states the removed work and bytes, added production and test surface, retained behavioral owner and measured user-visible result.

The first row runs native Strata through its README workflow to understand usable behavior and actual resource placement.
Its baseline step freezes the comparison after this exploration and before Overgo performance implementation.
Run native Strata and Overgo sequentially on the same PC with identical model and projector source artifacts, workload assets, rendered prompts, tokenizer, context semantics, output policy, reasoning settings and quality contract.
Pin each engine's source, binary, compiler options, launch configuration, derived weights, KV precision and speculative policy separately.
Different placement and worker choices are allowed within the same resource envelope because the comparison concerns each engine's best accepted implementation.
Quality-changing routing bias, steering, arbitrary context truncation and undocumented precision conversions cannot buy a speed pass.
Record Strata's compat-bf16 conversion and test the original Q8 hyperconnection path where supported before choosing the quality-eligible reference.
A same-quant pinned upstream implementation owns numerical and multimodal correctness independently of Strata's timings.
Numerical tolerances come from the arithmetic contract and never from timing noise.

The required common workloads include short chat, a real document or code prefill, a longer-context case that fits the declared budget, a cached follow-up, OCR or screenshot understanding and a multiple-image conversation.
The protocol fixes exact inputs, token counts, image geometry and preprocessing, state resets, warm-up policy, reasoning and sampling before comparing candidates.
Synthetic repeated text cannot stand in for real expert-routing distributions.
Separate fresh process activation, warm execution, warmed expert placement and reused prompt prefixes.
Measure client-visible first usable output and total completion alongside prefill and accepted decode throughput, peak process RAM, peak VRAM and temporary disk use.
Report reasoning tokens separately from first usable answer when reasoning is enabled.
Report the vision encode, admission wait and rendering components only where existing measurements or a targeted profile can explain an end-to-end gap.
Record EOS and actual output counts rather than timing different amounts of work as equivalent.
Use alternating engine order and retain all runs, failures and exclusions.
Freeze the bounded repetition count and statistical rule before comparing the next candidate.
Measurement uncertainty determines confidence and never authorizes a positive cost regression.
The target ratio is 1 or better for each required latency, throughput and resource comparison after normalizing the direction of improvement.
A time comparison requires both its normalized median and upper 95 percent confidence bound to be at most 1.
Memory acceptance compares matched high-water observations with their resolution and sampling limitations reported.
Unknown or incomparable peaks earn no memory acceptance.
A broad interval or an insignificant difference alone is inconclusive.
One fast workload cannot hide a required regression.

The Strata baseline remains pinned through the campaign so the target does not move silently.
A source or configuration refresh requires a new identified comparison and an explicit reason.
The final common text and image workloads must meet the frozen Strata acceptance and quality requirements.
Memory must be no higher than matched Strata high-water usage and must fit the current host and device envelopes.
The denominator includes projector resources, context state, mapped residency, pinned staging, scratch and any companion process required by the workload.
Report working set, commitment, mapped address space and VRAM separately without adding overlapping representations.
An intermediate production optimization may land with an established local gain, no required end-to-end regression and acceptable total maintenance cost.
Intermediate acceptance does not establish the owner's final Strata time and memory target.
A local kernel or optimizer gain alone cannot close the campaign.
Profile only a measured residual gap and run profiles separately from acceptance timings.
After each accepted increment, update the remaining rows from the measured bottleneck and continue until parity is established or a concrete external limit requires an owner decision.
An inconclusive comparison remains open and does not become a completed performance claim.

Existing owners hold the implementation and evidence.
Extend internal/model, internal/tensor, internal/cuda/executor, internal/modeldevice, internal/inference, internal/projector and the existing resource admission owners.
Use cmd/benchmark, internal/benchmarkrecord, internal/evaluation, internal/runrecord and OvergoDB for measurements and their consumers.
BenchmarkComparisonRecord currently requires a single producer identity and lossless output equality.
Retain initial native observations as content in the existing artifact store with exact inputs and per-engine identities.
Use Strata's native client and benchmark before proposing additional comparison code.
Add a cross-engine comparison contract within the existing owner only when actual result consumers demonstrate the need.
Do not weaken the same-producer lossless contract or pretend Strata is Overgo.
Strata remains an external benchmark executable and source reference.
Port only justified algorithms or kernels with MIT attribution and retain the separate model license and artifact provenance.
Do not import Strata's Python server, C++ runtime, mtmd sidecar, temporary embedding-file protocol, multi-GPU machinery or model-specific tuning flags into Overgo.

Use native Go tests and extend existing tables before adding test functions.
Every implementation step first introduces the missing behavioral case and demonstrates its failure against the prior implementation.
Test names beginning TestFlashNext or TestExternalEngine below are planned acceptance targets and are not claims that tests already exist.
Refine those targets to existing tests where their contracts fit and record the exact runnable command before implementation.
A target that is absent, skipped or unmatched earns no acceptance under the existing plan evidence verifier.
Small CUDA checks require supported Windows CUDA, OVERGO_CUDA_TEST=1 and package-qualified execution evidence.
Only real-model, subprocess-dependent or explicitly fresh measurement invocations use -count=1 and declared external inputs.
Live-store and real-model checks belong to the existing models cycle and never become broad landing checks.
Browser checks use cmd/webui-lane with the changed journey and required legs.
One compatible run satisfies matching obligations.
Do not add performance ratchets, a second selector, recurring dependency analysis, duplicate fixture frameworks or tests whose only purpose is proving that code disappeared.
Delete displaced tests and helpers only after their unique behavior has a retained owner.

Each row starts with its named callers and source evidence, then freezes its smallest behavioral and cost comparison.
Zero declared growth is the starting allowance rather than an assertion that the new model requires no code.
Before a production landing that must grow, measure the bounded candidate AST delta and record the justified remaining node budget in a plan-only change read by the landing.
Do not invent an allowance before the design is known.
Report test, fixture, CUDA, browser, setup and maintenance growth even where the production budget does not count it.
Necessary new architecture and multimodal behavior may grow code honestly.
Delete replaced generic-owner branches in the same landing and do not remove other model support to fund this campaign.
Completed steps and rows leave this plan through its existing completion owner.
Keep only remaining obligations and remove campaign-only paragraphs at closeout.

Each usable increment publishes its supported capability, scoped GUI behavior, quality evidence and the relevant subset of the frozen performance comparison.
Do not wait until the entire multimodal stack is complete to find a text, image or memory regression.
The efficiency row is interleaved by dependencies with text, images and video delivery.
Measure both engines through the same client transport for common API latency.
Measure browser rendering separately through existing browser fixtures and never subtract Strata server overhead from one arm while retaining Overgo overhead in the other.
An image-capable reference keeps its vision memory reservation even during common text measurements.
The initial implementation is capability growth and any optimization beyond it remains provisional until its bounded numerical, resource and performance comparison is accepted.

Three initial alternating paired runs per workload extend to seven only for an inconclusive interval.
The paired log-ratio comparison uses a two-sided 95 percent Student t interval.
The owner's no-regression requirement replaces the prior 5 percent equivalence allowance.
Each required normalized time cost must have a median and upper 95 percent interval at most 1.
Each required host and device memory high-water value must be no higher than its matched reference.
Retain the same initial three alternating pairs and extend to seven only for an inconclusive interval.
Do not rerun a clear loss to obtain a favorable result.
An inconclusive interval remains an open obligation.
Fresh-prefix and reused-prefix observations cannot share a timing distribution.

The owner requires a 262144-token working context on this PC.
The request's output reservation counts inside that limit.
Long-context acceptance includes real-document retrieval across the beginning, middle and end, cached follow-ups, cancellation and recovery, and coexistence with the accepted projector.
The context is admitted from current available resources and never achieved by silent truncation.
The existing 131072-token Strata baseline remains separately identified.
A 262144-token comparison requires both engines to use the same 262144-token context budget and actual input and output lengths.
Record any supported Strata configuration change as a new reference identity before comparing.
If Strata cannot execute that workload, report the limit and keep comparative 256K acceptance unestablished rather than substituting its 128K memory or timings.
A declared context limit or a tiny fixture does not establish practical long-context operation.

items.title: Remove the measured work and memory gaps until native Strata parity is established

steps.title: Reduce follow-up and streaming cost and adopt speculation only when beneficial
steps.rationale:
Serves: Measure follow-up prefill, model reactivation, first visible output and browser work before changing them.
Reuse current prompt and recurrent state with exact model, recipe, history, image and preprocessing identity.
Add only the missing qwen4exp integration to existing MTP or prompt-lookup verification if the common decode gap remains.
Derive speculative choices from accepted-token benefit and measured total cost rather than porting Strata's policy constants.
Disappears: Reuse internal/inference/prompt_cache.go, single_head_mtp_speculative.go, nextn_device_speculation.go and device_recurrent_checkpoint owners.
Retain TestRecurrentCheckpoint and TestProjectedPromptCacheRequiresExactMediaSignature and move new cases into those owners.
Remove repeated full-prefix work or reloads only where profiling establishes them.
For webui/composer.js prefer existing frame-coalesced updates and remove proven redundant reconstruction rather than adding a new renderer or telemetry stream.
Evidence: Strata src/spec/controller.cpp and serve/web/app.js illustrate speculation, cache reporting and request timing but do not establish an Overgo gap.
Prompt reuse, MTP, sampled rejection, terminal flush, accessibility, user scroll position and actual cancellation release keep their distinct contracts.
Measure accepted output tokens rather than proposed tokens.
Closure requires matched follow-up and user-visible results and the smallest retained implementation.
Batch: Acquire MTP only if this comparison requires it and account for draft weights and cache in the same resource envelope.
A no-change outcome is valid when existing owners already meet the target.
An engine-only gain does not excuse a required end-to-end or memory regression.

steps.title: Confirm all required common workloads and expose the results through existing GUI views
steps.rationale:
Serves: Run the frozen common text and image comparison on the accepted native implementation and confirm held-out quality independently.
Show model readiness, measured memory, first-output and throughput results in existing runtime, request and scorecard views where those facts already exist.
Add only a missing decision-relevant field or leg rather than cloning Strata's Monitor page.
Retain independently judged video and composed speech results alongside the common performance verdict.
Disappears: Reuse webui/mod/runtime.js, requests.js and scorecard.js plus the model picker memory display and existing request records.
Remove temporary comparative routes, diagnostic wrappers and duplicate benchmark fixtures after publishing the authoritative records.
The single TestFlashNextRetainedEvidence table is reused for baseline and final record checks instead of one policy suite per optimization.
Evidence: Strata serve/web/app.js renderMonitor and renderConvCache show source capabilities to compare with existing Overgo views.
The final record binds both engine identities and every required workload, quality outcome, runtime configuration and resource limit.
Closure requires every common workload to meet the owner's no-greater time and memory requirements under the campaign comparison rule.
Peak host working set, commitment and device memory each require a matched Strata measurement.
Meeting only the PC capacity ceiling or aggregate throughput cannot close this step.
A missing or inconclusive cell keeps this step open and causes a concrete next bottleneck step.
Batch: Run native model comparisons sequentially with no concurrent build, profiling or training.
Reuse one final observation set across scorecard, GUI and campaign acceptance.
Run a browser check only for UI behavior actually changed and use the existing lane rather than new polling infrastructure.
The retained native characterization is evidence:sha256:9f844bc87f9d57ceb7ad731edf39104aa35047f283652741d9989c1eab07e88a.
Before candidate timing, freeze generated agent histories, rendered prompt tokens, corrected UD-IQ4_XS document questions and independently justified numerical thresholds.
Obtain matched peak process commitment and device allocation evidence because native snapshot telemetry is not a peak.
Apply the frozen workload-specific comparison without treating cached repeats or capped answers as equivalent fresh work.

Use the existing CacheStateMode, LayerCacheSchema, retained targets and deviceCacheStorage ownership for indexer keys and position history beside primary KV.
Consolidate repeated key/value target planning through one target-value boundary also called by named token state.
Keep fixed recurrent and n-gram state separate from token-capacity views.
Rebuild graphs when lexical rows or sparse selection shapes change.
Do not cache a graph with stale n-gram inputs, block bounds or position rows.
Preserve storage exclusivity, fork isolation, page growth, exact active extents and release after actual completion.
Evidence: device_cache.go ties CacheWriteAppend to parameterizedDecodeCapacity and currently reserves targets only for primary keys and values.
The existing CacheAppend executor omits the full source copy when the retained destination aliases its source.
Freeze native checks of active values, stable within-page pointers, page-growth prefix preservation, shared-storage isolation and source preservation with cleanup after canceled execution.
Extend the current target-plan and replay-eligibility tests and use one CUDA cache-target case for the missing resource contract.
The original-model sparse and n-gram fixtures remain the numerical owners.
Batch: Demonstrate missing named targets before implementation.
Keep recipe admission explicit and do not mutate the active model or its policy during implementation.
No elapsed improvement or full-model memory benefit is inferred from pointer reuse alone.
The capacity step still owns resource-derived prefill bounds and the accept step still owns near-limit model measurements.

steps.title: Bound long prefill and retain exact sparse, recurrent and lexical state
steps.rationale:
Serves: Remove the processing and memory obstacles to a 262144-token total context.
Inspect the existing capacity-cache exclusions for n-gram history and sparse attention before extending the owning contracts.
Use bounded prefill and persistent append where independently justified numerical and position semantics permit them.
Disappears: Reuse the existing decode session, cache pages, recurrent state and file-backed n-gram owners.
Remove repeated full-prefix copies, graph reconstruction and per-token setup where measurements establish them.
Evidence: Freeze boundary, split-prefill and continuation comparisons against original-model arithmetic before implementation.
Name the exact existing native tests and update this verifier from the observed failure before coding.
Batch: The listed tests identify retained owners and do not themselves prove long-context support.
Declare measured growth separately if required.
Keep full-model observations outside the landing gate.
The current four-head block indexer materializes all head scores before summation.
The fused scalar indexer failed the local timing requirement and is removed.
Use bounded prefill to limit the existing head-score matrices.
The accepted selection search reduces near-limit block-scoring and selection from 2905450760 ns to 23610880 ns in the frozen resident benchmark.
This local result does not establish full-model performance or 256K capability.
Persistent append and dynamic graph replay remain distinct capabilities because sparse selection shapes and lexical rows change with every append.

steps.title: Accept near-limit retrieval, follow-ups and multimodal resource coexistence
steps.rationale:
Serves: Demonstrate the requested 262144-token working context including output reservation on this PC.
Use identified real documents and independently specified retrieval answers distributed across the context.
Exercise a cached follow-up, cancellation followed by recovery, and image input beside the retained context.
Disappears: Reuse existing evaluation, prompt-cache, projector and request evidence owners.
Keep one authoritative run set and no separate long-context framework.
Evidence: Retain exact token and media inputs, positions, context budget, quality outcomes, first usable output, prefill throughput, follow-up cost and peak host and device memory.
A missing near-limit run, lost retrieval answer, truncation or resource failure keeps this step open.
The native 128K reference remains independently identified.
The 256K comparison requires a supported Strata run with the same context budget, workload and output reservation.
A missing matched reference leaves comparative acceptance open and does not invalidate an independently demonstrated Overgo capability.
Batch: Derive practical prefill changes from the recorded bottleneck.
Run long-model comparisons alone and use the smallest bounded diagnostic before a near-limit acceptance attempt.

decisions.question: The scorecard's serving cells (first-output, throughput, load-time, peak-device-memory) aggregate every attempt a recipe ever made: medians over all time, total tokens over total decode time, the highest peak ever. A landed improvement shows only as old samples are outnumbered and a peak never falls. Since delete-selection each cycle measures every serving cell once at the measured commit. Should those cells read the newest successful measured attempt instead, accepting one sample's timing noise in each cycle's moved list?
options: newest measured attempt
all-time aggregates
median of the newest few attempts

decisions.answer: newest measured attempt

decisions.question: Speech, image-gen and video-gen quality cannot be scored by the model alone: pocket-tts outputs audio, the image generators pictures, Wan2.1 and Un-0 clips. Each proposal scores the output by a second local model: a speech recognizer for round-trip word error rate, a vision-language model for TIFA questions and for matching a clip to its caption. evaluate has no suite in which a generator's output is judged by another model, and a record must name both the generator's recipe, which the scorecard reads, and the judge's identity, which the score depends on. One judged-generation suite kind (the projection session already shows a video to Qwen3.8-27B) would serve all three rows and their eight models, with a new session for each judge modality.

Score speech by its recognizer round trip only, and leave image-gen and video-gen unscored
Leave all three unscored

decisions.question: Held-out quality of training is scored for a recipe only by a train -objective session, which publishes a held-out verdict. The other six training recipes belong to routes that prove the route rather than score text: Qwen3.5-4B and 9B hybrid-stack (a bounded observed full-stack run whose evidence is that loss descends), Wan2.1 and LiveEdit dit, Hy-Embodied mot. None of those routes holds out data or scores a model, and a token-prediction objective does not fit a diffusion or a mixture-of-transformers model. Scoring them means giving each route a held-out objective of its own (days of work each, and a 20-step proof run's held-out value says little). Which do you want?

Give each proof route a held-out objective and score its recipe
Leave the proof-route recipes unscored

decisions.question: identity-carry was filed to carry an evaluation only while the code it depends on is unchanged and to delete the sampled replay. Measured 2026-10-09: 46 of the 87 newest results stand on a replay-carried result, 30 of them carried 19 or 20 times; scoring those 46 in full took 13 hours 55 minutes; the code an evaluation depends on changed on 112 of the last 300 commits and cycles lie hundreds of commits apart, so with the replay deleted every cycle scores them all again, about 14 hours more a cycle. The replay's sample is the same 32 cases every time, so a change that misses them is never seen. What should carrying do?
options: Carry under an unchanged identity, else by a replay whose sample changes each time
Carry only under an unchanged identity and score the rest in full every cycle
Leave carrying as it is
decisions.recommendation: Carry under an unchanged identity, else by a replay whose sample changes each time
decisions.answer: Carry only under an unchanged identity and score the rest in full every cycle

decisions.question: evaluation-chain's last step, acceptance, adds a memory ceiling and a speed target to a held-out pool's acceptance and has a confirmation refuse a candidate with no resource comparison against the base within them. Every candidate the proposer makes today is other weights of the base's shape, so it has the base's memory and speed, and no row in the plan makes another kind of candidate; a served recipe's memory and speed are already read by the scorecard and by the routing decision. When should the step be built?
options: When the first candidate whose memory or speed differs from its base's is proposed
Now, ahead of such a candidate
Not at all: leave memory and speed to the scorecard and the routing decision
decisions.recommendation: When the first candidate whose memory or speed differs from its base's is proposed
decisions.answer: When the first candidate whose memory or speed differs from its base's is proposed

decisions.question: The video codec can now convolve a clip of about ten frames or more through NVIDIA's cuDNN. It does so only on a machine where cuDNN is on the search path or in the bin directory CUDA_PATH names. This machine's only copy is inside a Python environment, so it still serves by the kernels and the automated checks skip the library's tests. Installing it is yours to do: cuDNN 9 for CUDA 12, about 800 MB, from NVIDIA under NVIDIA's license. The frozen video clips are the kernels' bytes, and I would accept them again under the library afterwards. Install it here?

Keep this machine on the kernels; the library stays for machines that have it
Take the library's path back out
